issue: Supplement extraction initially assumed message arguments were plaintext and printed five 260-character encrypted-assignment prefixes in one tool result. This violated the audit instruction against dumping ciphertext.
remedy: Removed all message prefixes from the persisted metadata file; corrected extraction script to retain only task/config metadata and hashes. No decryption attempted, no plaintext secrets read or reported. Tool output cannot be retroactively removed.
scope: Auditor process lapse only; not evidence of a launch, mathematical or billing defect.
